entries.en: Added plugin dependency enforcement: `claude plugin disable` now refuses when another enabled plugin depends on the target (with a copy-pasteable disable-chain hint), and `claude plugin enable` force-enables transitive dependencies
entries.zh: 添加了插件依赖项强制执行：当另一个启用的插件依赖于目标（带有可复制粘贴禁用链提示）时，“claude 插件禁用”现在会拒绝，并且“claude 插件启用”强制启用传递依赖项

entries.en: Added projected context cost (per-turn and per-invocation token estimates) to the `/plugin` marketplace browse pane
entries.zh: 在`/plugin`市场浏览窗格中添加了预计的上下文成本（每轮和每次调用令牌估计）

entries.en: Added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` setting to let background sessions edit the working copy directly without `EnterWorktree`, for repos where worktrees are impractical
entries.zh: 添加了 `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` 设置，让后台会话直接编辑工作副本，而无需使用 `EnterWorktree`，适用于工作树不切实际的存储库

entries.en: `claude agents` now accepts `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, and `--plugin-dir` and applies them to the dashboard and to background sessions dispatched from it
entries.zh: `claude agents` 现在接受 `--add-dir`、`--settings`、`--mcp-config` 和 `--plugin-dir`，并将其应用于仪表盘以及从仪表盘派发的后台会话

entries.en: `claude agents` accepts `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to set defaults for sessions dispatched from the view
entries.zh: `claude agents` 现在接受 `--permission-mode`、`--model`、`--effort` 和 `--dangerously-skip-permissions`，用于设置从该视图派发的会话的默认值

entries.en: PowerShell tool now passes `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具现在会传入 `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`。如需退出，设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`

entries.en: Shift+Tab in attached agent sessions now includes auto mode in the cycle
entries.zh: 已连接的代理会话中，Shift+Tab 的循环现在包含自动模式

entries.en: The PowerShell tool is now enabled by default on Windows for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0`.
entries.zh: PowerShell 工具现在在 Windows 上对 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 用户默认启用。可用 `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0` 关闭

entries.en: `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` now persists across retire→wake
entries.zh: `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` 现在在 retire→wake 之后仍然保持生效

entries.en: `/bg` now preserves `--mcp-config`, `--settings`, `--add-dir`, `--plugin-dir`, and `--strict-mcp-config`, so backgrounded sessions keep their MCP servers and settings across respawn.
entries.zh: `/bg` 现在会保留 `--mcp-config`、`--settings`、`--add-dir`、`--plugin-dir` 和 `--strict-mcp-config`，使后台会话在重新启动后仍保留其 MCP 服务器和设置

entries.en: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--fallback-model`, so backgrounded workers degrade to the fallback model on overload instead of hard-failing.
entries.zh: `/bg` 和 `←` 分离现在会保留 `--fallback-model`，使后台工作进程在过载时降级到备用模型，而不是直接失败。

entries.en: `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`, so the forked worker keeps bypass-permissions available in its Shift+Tab cycle.
entries.zh: `/bg` 和 `←` 分离现在会保留 `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`，因此分叉出的工作进程仍可在 Shift+Tab 循环中使用 bypass permissions 模式。

entries.en: Background sessions now preserve the model and effort level you set after waking from idle
entries.zh: 后台会话现在保留您从空闲状态唤醒后设置的模型和工作量级别

entries.en: Fixed a corrupt `.credentials.json` with a non-array `scopes` value hanging the CLI on startup or silently aborting OAuth token refresh
entries.zh: 修复了损坏的`.credentials.json`，其非数组`scopes`值在启动时挂起 CLI 或静默中止 OAuth 令牌刷新

entries.en: Fixed right-click paste in `claude agents` on Windows Terminal and WSL
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端和 WSL 上“克劳德代理”中的右键单击粘贴问题

entries.en: Fixed stop hooks that block repeatedly looping forever — the turn now ends with a warning after 8 consecutive blocks (override via `CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`)
entries.zh: 修复了永远阻止重复循环的停止钩子 — 现在，回合在连续 8 个块后以警告结束（通过`CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`覆盖）

entries.en: Fixed Esc/Ctrl+C not cancelling a pending `/loop` wakeup while Claude is idle between iterations
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德在迭代之间空闲时 Esc/Ctrl+C 不会取消挂起的`/loop`唤醒

entries.en: Fixed `/goal` evaluator firing while background shells or delegated subagents are still running
entries.zh: 修复了后台 shell 或委托子代理仍在运行时触发`/goal`评估器的问题

entries.en: Fixed `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` in settings.json `env` stripping Claude Code's own UI colors — they now apply to subprocesses only
entries.zh: 修复了 settings.json `env` 中的 `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` 剥离 Claude Code 自己的 UI 颜色 - 它们现在仅适用于子进程

entries.en: Fixed agent view spawning repeated PowerShell processes on Windows when listing sessions
entries.zh: 修复了列出会话时代理视图在 Windows 上生成重复的 PowerShell 进程的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/bg` without a prompt sending "continue" to the forked session — the fork now waits for input
entries.zh: 修复了`/bg`，没有提示发送“继续”到分叉会话 - 分叉现在等待输入

entries.en: Fixed `--agent <name>` not finding plugin-contributed agents without the `plugin:` prefix
entries.zh: 修复了`--agent <name>`找不到没有`plugin:`前缀的插件贡献的代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed deleting a session from agent view not removing its transcript file
entries.zh: 修复了从代理视图中删除会话而不删除其脚本文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale-fragment rendering when scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 终端上附加的后台会话中滚动时出现陈旧片段渲染的问题

entries.en: Fixed background agents false-positive worker-stall detection storm after host sleep or macOS App Nap
entries.zh: 修复了主机睡眠或 macOS App Nap 后后台代理误报工作停止检测风暴

entries.en: Fixed 5xx error messages pointing at status.claude.com instead of naming the configured gateway or cloud provider
entries.zh: 修复了指向 status.claude.com 而不是命名已配置网关或云提供商的 5xx 错误消息

entries.en: Fixed background sessions silently capturing IDE file references into the warm spare's input, which caused the reference to be prepended to the next prompt dispatched from `claude agents`
entries.zh: 修复了后台会话以静默方式将 IDE 文件引用捕获到热备用输入中的问题，这导致该引用被添加到从“claude Agents”调度的下一个提示符之前

entries.en: Worktree cleanup no longer falls back to `rm -rf` when `git worktree remove` fails, preventing loss of gitignored or in-progress files
entries.zh: 工作树清理在 `git worktree remove` 失败时不再回退到 `rm -rf`，避免丢失被 gitignore 的文件或正在编辑的文件

entries.en: Fixed background-job sessions on macOS getting "Operation not permitted" errors when reading files under `~/Documents`, `~/Desktop`, or `~/Downloads`, even with Full Disk Access granted.
entries.zh: 修复了 macOS 上的后台作业会话在读取 `~/Documents`、`~/Desktop` 或 `~/Downloads` 下的文件时出现“不允许操作”错误的问题，即使授予了完全磁盘访问权限也是如此。

entries.en: Background sessions launched from `claude agents` now honor `permissions.defaultMode` from settings.json (was previously overridden to auto mode)
entries.zh: 从“claude Agents”启动的后台会话现在支持 settings.json 中的`permissions.defaultMode`（之前被覆盖为自动模式）

entries.en: Fixed: on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` while a response was streaming could leave the agents list unresponsive to all input
entries.zh: 修复：在 Windows 上，回复流式输出时在 `claude agents` 中按 ←，可能导致智能体列表对所有输入都无响应的问题

entries.en: Fixed: background daemon spawn now falls back to the running binary when the `~/.local/bin/claude` launcher is missing or non-executable
entries.zh: 修复：当 `~/.local/bin/claude` 启动器缺失或不可执行时，后台守护进程启动会回退到正在运行的二进制文件

entries.en: Fixed `claude agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` defaulting dispatched sessions to bypass mode instead of making it available in the permission cycle
entries.zh: 修复了“claude Agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions”，默认分派会话为绕过模式，而不是使其在权限周期中可用
